**Group:** Detritus  ·  **Optics:** high-mag, low-mag

## Defining characteristics

A non-living detrital particle from zooplankton grazing, in the short form: a stubby ovoid, ellipsoidal, or near-spherical compact mass with a defined outline, denser and more regular than a loose aggregate and sometimes membrane-bound. Length is similar to width. Key features: short ovoid/rounded shape, defined outline, compact contents.

## Distinguishing from similar classes

| Similar class | How to tell them apart |
|---|---|
| **fecal_pellet_long** | The long form is distinctly elongated and rod-like; the short form is stubby with length close to width. |
| **aggregate** | Aggregates are loose, irregular flocs with diffuse edges; fecal pellets are compact particles with a defined outline. |
